evidence: M-O s.v. genetics: cell (biology), after the Austrian pharmacopoeia
terms.comment: Classically a little room or store-room (Ter. Eun. 309). The cells of a honeycomb are cellae: nōn in favō sex angulīs cella, totidem quot habet ipsa pedēs? (Varro, RR 3.16.5), and Comenius’s bees build cellulās sexangulārēs (OP 47). Morgan–Owens marks the biological sense as modern.
